# The Hershey glyphs the handwriting's templates take (ws165-p002), and their Unicode character: a Hershey number and
# the code point in hexadecimal, a line each.  The numbers and the code points were taken from Kaloffl's
# Hershey-Unicode-Mapping (https://github.com/Kaloffl/Hershey-Unicode-Mapping, hershey_to_unicode_occidental.csv and
# hershey_to_unicode_oriental.csv, released under the Unlicense, fetched 2026-10-06): the simplex Roman capitals
# (501-526), small letters (601-626), digits (700-709) and twenty signs; the oriental hiragana and katakana (6000-6179),
# the first glyph of each character.
